title: [IMP-04] Set up PPAP issue and approval facts
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-04

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-04

Title
Set up PPAP issue and approval facts

Category
Fields and forms

Objective
Preserve who issued, confirmed, cancelled and approved each PPAP without allowing direct edits to decision evidence.

Detailed scope
Add the PPAP issue, confirmation, replacement-hold, review, cancellation and approval fields and their stage-aware controls. Provide separate internal return comments and frozen certificate labels; retain the existing PPAP Completion Date field definition.

Deliverable
Decision controls that the named PPAP actions can populate while users cannot rewrite history.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-03 — Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-03 provides the PPAP facility/drawing/part/warrant fields and target due/display settings.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: the local decision fields and stage controls can proceed; supplier actor and certificate-label/reference bindings wait for the listed information.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP.Management Approver Pool
Create a link to Group, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Administrator sets governed eligible group; mandatory before Issue when any selected part Important Safety?=TRUE. Field/control lifecycle: Current membership validated on final action; no HR Immediate Supervisor shortcut.

PPAP.Final Management Approver
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects current eligible pool member before Complete PPAP when management required; otherwise NULL and hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Assign/reassign only while open, notify; SIA PPAP Engineer can select self if eligible; no automatic stage bypass.

PPAP.Issued Overall Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; mandatory once issued. Field/control lifecycle: Issue snapshots PPAP Due Date once.

PPAP.Issued At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Issue writes authenticated server timestamp once; retained after closure.

PPAP.Issued By
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Issue writes actual actor.

PPAP.Scope Confirmed At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Confirm Scope supplier action writes once; no mass requirement at this point.

PPAP.Scope Confirmed By
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Confirm Scope writes authenticated supplier actor; actual platform external-user identity binding must be verified.

PPAP.Replacement Required?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: FALSE. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; internal warning and supplier non-technical action hold. Field/control lifecycle: Source correction handler sets TRUE only for authoritative criticality correction applicable to this issued original context; blocks finalization until SIA PPAP Engineer cancels/replaces. Different engineering revision alone never sets it.

PPAP.Replacement Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required when Replacement Required?=TRUE, otherwise NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Source correction handler stores affected context and changed flags; reason persists on cancellation.

PPAP.Management Submitted At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Complete PPAP writes current submission/resubmission time on entry to Management Review; native workflow retains each prior entry.

PPAP.Management Review Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; hidden unless Management Review or its history. Field/control lifecycle: Complete PPAP computes local submission date plus current policy Management Review Days; freeze for that review cycle.

PPAP.Management Return Comment
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Current eligible management approver; internal only; required for Return for More Information; otherwise retain prior value read only. Field/control lifecycle: Return Action Handler validates nonblank, writes audit/workflow history; never include in supplier notification.

PPAP.Cancellation Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Responsible SIA PPAP Engineer or PPAP administrator through Cancel PPAP only; required on cancellation; otherwise NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Cancel writes before cascade; preserve after terminal cancellation.

PPAP.Cancelled At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Cancel PPAP writes only after outstanding work cascade succeeds.

PPAP.Cancelled By
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Cancel PPAP writes actual actor after successful cascade.

PPAP.Approved At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Final approval or non-safety Complete PPAP writes once, in same successful save as fixed output creation.

PPAP.Approved By
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Records actual authenticated approving actor; SIA PPAP Engineer for non-safety; eligible management actor for safety.

PPAP.Approved Manufacturing Facility Label
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required at approval, NULL beforehand. Field/control lifecycle: Approval Action Handler snapshots Manufacturing Facility native display value with its stable identity; native display-field binding verified under certificate gate; fixed source for certificate rendering/authorized retry.

PPAP.Approved Supplier Label
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required at approval, NULL beforehand. Field/control lifecycle: Approval Action Handler snapshots Manufacturing Facility.ParentCompany native display value; exact existing shared field binding verified before build; stable facility/company identity remains in shared relationship; fixed certificate evidence.

PPAP.Approved Authority Label
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required at approval, NULL beforehand. Field/control lifecycle: Approval Action Handler snapshots authenticated Approved By native display value; actual actor identity remains Approved By; label fixed so later person-name changes cannot rewrite certificate.

PPAP.Certificate Reference
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; authorized supplier/internal view after approval. Field/control lifecycle: Approve allocates unique opaque reference; verification always requires authorized access; QR optional, no public endpoint assumed.

PPAP.Approval Certificate
Use the Intelex native attachment collection, retaining file identity, name, length and content type. Do not create a custom file table. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Read only authorized download after approval. Field/control lifecycle: Approval renderer creates controlled PDF from approved frozen package; exactly one active issued artifact, retry by Certificate Reference; retain original bytes.

Build instructions
1. Show Management Return Comment only to authorized internal users; require a nonblank value only through Return for More Information. Keep it out of supplier screens and messages.
2. Require Cancellation Reason only through Cancel PPAP and Replacement Reason when Replacement Required?=TRUE. Keep other action-stamped dates, people, labels and reference fields read only on forms and direct update paths.
3. Use native audit for changes and action history. Provide no direct closed-record edit, interim approval, withdrawal or post-closure discussion control. The approval/cancellation action assignments own the actual writes, not an additional Save process here.

How to check the result
• Supplier users cannot see internal management comments or edit issue/approval/cancellation stamps.
• Approval labels and certificate reference have no ordinary editor; a replacement hold clearly prevents finalization without changing issued scope.

Information needed for this task
IN-06: Supply external supplier-to-native actor and record/file visibility bindings for Scope Confirmed By and protected decision controls; the ordinary local fields can proceed.
IN-11: Supply native facility/company/person display-field sources for the three frozen approval labels and the certificate attachment/reference connection.
IN-05: Supply approved management-pool group and eligible final-approver reference identifiers for the decision controls; the local date/reason/label fields can proceed.

Supplied input context
• IN-06 — Record visibility, file access and supplier actor connection: The security/technical team must supply visibility classification values and access rules, native record/file/API/export enforcement methods, authorized handover principals, and the supported external-supplier-user to native actor/recipient identity connection. This information limits the affected security, posting, confirmation and recorded-actor settings.
• IN-11 — Approval certificate and authorized verification route: SIA must supply the approved certificate layout and required supplier/facility identity labels. The technical team must supply native PDF generation, saved-file/opaque-reference handling, authenticated verification route and native display-field sources for frozen approval labels. Optional QR rendering does not block the ordinary PDF.
• IN-05 — Approved SIA roles, supplier roles and capability rules: The SRM/security owners must supply the governed library-role and exact-entity role identifiers, populated memberships, SIA engineer selections, inspection teams/leaders, management approver pool and PPAP administrator group. They must also supply central ACTIVE/SERVICE/INACTIVE capability identifiers and reconcile the annotated central open-work transition rule. These are existing shared authorities; membership administration and central policy decisions are outside the build assignments.

Specification references

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
